h2: One-Off Pool Cleaning Kuta & Legian, Bali
intro: Pool Cleaning Kuta & Legian is a practical service for villa owners, guesthouse managers and long-term tenants who need a thorough reset without committing to a weekly contract. We handle skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and full water balance in one visit — whether your pool sits behind Jl. Padma or down a lane in Tuban.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Flooding Lanes and Old Piping
sections.text: Kuta and Legian sit close enough to the beach that salt-laden air eats through stainless steel ladders, return jets and pump fittings faster than inland. In heavy rain, low-lying lanes around Tuban and Kuta Beach turn into streams, dragging sand, leaves and insects straight into your pool basin. Add decades of ageing drainage beneath these streets and you get a constant supply of organic matter that turns clear water green within days if left unchecked.

sections.h3: What We Usually Handle in Guesthouses & Villas
sections.text: The most common request from a Legian guesthouse manager is a full clean before a group booking lands — skimming every corner, brushing the waterline where calcium and algae build up, vacuuming the floor and running a proper filter backwash so trapped sand doesn't recirculate. Private villa owners on Jl. Padma often call after a long dry stretch when the pool has gone cloudy or outright green. Either way, we test and rebalance chlorine, pH and alkalinity as part of the same visit.

Message us on WhatsApp with two or three clear photos: one wide shot of the whole pool, one close-up of the waterline or any discolouration, and one of the filter area if accessible. Tell us roughly how many days it's been since anyone touched the water and whether there are visible algae patches or just cloudiness. The cost depends entirely on what the job requires; once we see the photos we'll give you a straight figure before anything is booked in.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Pool Clear Between Visits
sections.text: A simple pool cover saves hours of work after every monsoon downpour — Kuta's lanes don't drain fast enough to keep debris out of an uncovered basin. Run the pump at least four hours daily even when no one swims; stagnant water in this humidity breeds algae overnight. Once a month, wipe the waterline and inspect metal fittings near Kuta Beach for early pitting. Catching a small leak or corroded jet now means a quick fix instead of a full replacement later.

faq.q: What does a one-off pool clean include?
faq.a: Skimming, brushing all surfaces, vacuuming the floor, filter backwash and a full chemical test-and-rebalance — everything completed in a single visit.

faq.q: Can you recover a pool that has turned completely green?
faq.a: Yes. We shock-treat, brush heavily, run extended filtration cycles and retest over the following days until clarity returns; the exact process depends on how far along the algae growth is.

faq.q: Do I need to be home while you're working?
faq.a: No — most villa managers and owners send us access details via WhatsApp beforehand and we handle the entire job independently.
